name: Poor Search Relevance
description: Tests the agent's ability to filter out noise and return the specific document requested.
business_problem: Employees cannot find what they need because search retrieves too many irrelevant pages.
success_criteria: The agent must retrieve the exact document/section answering the specific query, ranking it #1.

name: Information Overload
description: Tests the agent's ability to synthesize a concise answer from multiple verbose sources.
business_problem: Slack channels and Wikis grow non-stop; nobody knows where the 'source of truth' is.
success_criteria: The agent must provide a summary answer of under 100 words that captures the key facts without dumping raw text.

name: Outdated or Conflicting Docs
description: Tests the agent's ability to identify and prioritize the most recent or authoritative source when contradictions exist.
business_problem: Docs often contradict Slack threads or old versions. Developers follow broken steps.
success_criteria: The agent must explicitly identify the conflict and cite the newer/authoritative source, warning about the older one.

name: WordPress Local Setup
description: Tests the agent's ability to provide setup instructions for a specific project (WordPress).
business_problem: New hires spend too much time on environmental setup due to fragmented documentation.
success_criteria: The agent must provide a clear list of setup steps and cite the relevant project documentation.
